info.name: Render Public Audit Logs Registry Credentials API

params.name: name
params.description: Filter for the name of a credential

params.name: username
params.description: Filter for the username of a credential

params.name: type
params.description: Filter for the registry type for the credential

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Filter for services created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Filter for services created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: updatedBefore
params.description: Filter for services updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: updatedAfter
params.description: Filter for services updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: ownerId
params.description: The ID of the workspaces to return resources for

params.name: cursor
params.description: The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

items.docs: List registry credentials matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, returns all registry credentials you have permissions to view.

params.name: registryCredentialId
params.description: The ID of the registry credential

items.docs: Retrieve the registry credential with the provided ID.

params.name: registryCredentialId
params.description: The ID of the registry credential

items.docs: Update the registry credential with the provided ID. Services that use this credential must be redeployed to use updated values.

params.name: registryCredentialId
params.description: The ID of the registry credential

items.docs: Delete the registry credential with the provided ID.
